{value}

') (out / 'Native@Phone.xml').write_text(f'') (out / 'Tree@Phone.json').write_text(json.dumps({'label': str(value), 'frame': [1, 2, 3, 4]})) (out / 'Text@Phone.txt').write_text(f'{value}\n') (out / 'Stable@Phone.txt').write_text('Same\n')

') (out / 'Native@Phone.xml').write_text(f'') (out / 'Tree@Phone.json').write_text(json.dumps({'label': str(value), 'frame': [1, 2, 3, 4]})) (out / 'Text@Phone.txt').write_text(f'{value}\n') (out / 'Stable@Phone.txt').write_text('Same\n')

[probe.metric]
run = ["python3", "probe.py"]
outputs = ["out/metric.json"]
kind = "number"
noise = 0.01
fail_over = 0.2
[probe.screens]
run = ["python3", "screens.py"]
outputs = ["out/screens"]
kind = "screenshots"
fail_over = 0.5
